source: Dev-PROPOSED starter registry per answer tspi 25.07.2026.pdf Q3 (Option A: phenotypes are NAMED, VERSIONED patterns; structure is Symptom -> Phenotype -> Axis). Seeded from the symptom-dictionary clusters. Every entry is status=CANDIDATE and MUST be reviewed/approved by a domain expert before it is authoritative.
model_note: A phenotype is a named clinical pattern, not a single symptom and not a disease. It sits BETWEEN symptoms and axes: matched phenotypes propose candidate axes with weights; they never assert an axis on their own.
